prompt: Implement undo and redo for the event-sourced board. Each successful command is undoable; undo and redo return true when they change the board and false when their stack is empty. A new command after undo discards the redo branch. History must survive snapshot compaction and reopening the journal, and every projection must reflect replayed actions. Preserve task order when restoring a removed task. Run `node --test`. Do not edit, delete, or skip protected tests. Use the built-in Node toolchain only.
